items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 10:07PM AKDT until October 11 at 6:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 7:24PM AKDT until October 11 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts of 50 to 70 mph.

* WHERE...Anchorage Hillside

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are expected over Rabbit
Creek, Potter Creek, Turnagain Arm and Bear Valley.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 10 at 6:52PM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 8 inches along
portions of the Parks Highway. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may
result in areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Southern Denali Borough, especially south of Denali Park.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected tonight through
Saturday night. Rain may mix in on Saturday, but roads and
especially bridges are likely to become slick and snow covered.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 10 at 6:52PM AKDT until October 11 at 8:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snowfall of 4 to 8 inches has already fallen.
Additional snow accumulations of 2 to 4 inches are expected by
Sunday morning.

* WHERE...South Slopes Of The Central Brooks Range including the
Dalton Highway between mileposts 175 and 209.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected this evening through
Sunday morning. Roads and especially bridges are already slick and
snow covered.
items.areas: South Slopes Of The Central Brooks Range
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. Visit 511.alaska.gov or call 5 1 1
for the latest road conditions.

Persons should consider delaying travel. Motorists should use extreme
caution if travel is absolutely necessary.
